bounded_conclusions: For the drainage-free F-GC45 real-Richards fixture, production u is locally the whole-column storage sensitivity dS/dH within about 2e-5 relative over the preregistered admitted head band.
The accepted physical bottom-outward exchange has the opposite sensitivity: dE_bottom_out/dH = -u to the same accuracy.
The head sensitivity of storage change plus bottom-outward exchange cancels exactly in the observed transaction mass ledger because the remaining external forcing is head-independent in this fixture.
MAP02's sign inversion is therefore physically explained at the storage-versus-bottom-exchange level; it is not numerical noise.

This does not yet establish whether production q_u's full affine derivative is wrong, because q_u contains both a storage-change term and qbot. That full historical derivative must be audited explicitly.
next: Audit the derivative of the complete historical q_u = u*dH/dt - qbot relation under the qbot-to-head inverse response.
Search SWAP4/SIMGRO historical authority for whether qbot is held fixed or varies with H in the intended MODFLOW response.
Only then decide whether F-GC40/F-GC33's dq_u/dH = +u/dt is a semantic mismatch or an intended decomposition.
